DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は相談したいことを、メモにまとめてこられましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you bring notes summarizing what you would like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 十個書いてきましたが、全部を最初から読むと長くなります。今日中に決めたいことから相談してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十質問を期限優先で相談したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote down ten things, but reading everything from the beginning would take a long time. May I start with the things I need to decide today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to discuss your ten questions in order of their deadlines. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。特に急ぐことと、急がないことを分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. Please separate the particularly urgent matters from those that are not urgent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一番急ぐのは、明日出す申込書の相談先です。公園の行事と講座のことは、今日決めなくても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 明日申込を急ぎ行事講座を後回しにする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The most urgent thing is finding out whom to consult about the application form I am submitting tomorrow. I do not need to decide about the park event and the course today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that tomorrow's application is urgent and leave the event and course until later. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 申込書を先に見ましょう。担当へ聞きたい質問は、何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us look at the application form first. What would you like to ask the person in charge?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 不足している欄を今日補えるかです。行事の質問を一緒に混ぜず、この用紙について先に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不足欄補充を当該用紙担当へ尋ねたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Whether I can fill in the missing sections today. I will ask about this form first, without mixing in my questions about the event.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to ask the person responsible for this form about completing the missing sections. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この申込書の担当へおつなぎします。残りの質問は、手元のメモに残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will put you in touch with the person responsible for this application form. Please keep the remaining questions in your notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つ終わったら印を付けます。急いでいるから十個とも同じ担当へ答えてもらうつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 済印を付け担当へ全件回答を求めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will mark each one when it is finished. Being in a hurry does not mean I intend to ask the same person to answer all ten.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will mark completed items and will not ask that person to answer everything. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日のご案内は、この用紙の相談先まで確認できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Today we have established whom you can consult about this form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。ここで分かったことと、担当へこれから聞くことを分けてメモし、未回答の行事の質問も残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内済情報と未回答質問を分けて残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will make separate notes of what I learned here and what I still need to ask the person in charge, and keep the unanswered questions about the event too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the information already provided separate from the unanswered questions. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、申込書の担当へご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Now I will direct you to the person responsible for the application form. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 手首について、どのような感じがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: What does your wrist feel like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「ずきずき」と「じんじん」のどちらかを選ぶと、うまく言えません。物を持った時のことから説明してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 擬態語選択より動作の具体例で説明したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Choosing between 'throbbing' and 'tingling' does not let me describe it well. May I start by explaining what happens when I hold something?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to explain through specific actions rather than choosing a descriptive sensation word. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。何をする時に、どのような変化があるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. Please tell me what changes you notice when you do particular things.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 空のコップは持てますが、水を入れた物は持ち上げると痛くなります。手を動かさずにいる時は弱いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空コップと水入りと安静時の違いを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can hold an empty cup, but lifting one filled with water hurts. It is milder when I keep my hand still.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the differences between an empty cup, a cup of water, and resting. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: いつから続いていますか。分かる範囲で結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: How long has this been happening? Just tell me what you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の昼、掃除を終えた後に気付きました。掃除が原因だと分かったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 掃除後気付いた時点と原因未確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I noticed it yesterday at midday, after I finished cleaning. That does not mean I know cleaning caused it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain when you noticed it after cleaning and that the cause is unconfirmed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 気付いた時と、原因の判断を分けてお伝えいただければ大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is fine to tell us separately when you noticed it and what you think about the cause.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の説明を先生にも伝えてください。痛みを見せるために、ここで重い物を持って試すことはしたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 医師伝達と重物実演をしない希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please pass that explanation on to the doctor too. I do not want to try lifting something heavy here to demonstrate the pain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the explanation to be passed to the doctor and say you do not want to demonstrate with a heavy object. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 実際に試す必要はありません。ほかに日常で困った動作はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You do not need to actually try it. Are there other everyday movements you have had trouble with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ドアの丸い取っ手を回す時も困りました。表現の言葉を無理に選ぶより、コップと取っ手の違いを問診票に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取っ手の困難も加え具体動作を問診へ記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Turning a round doorknob was difficult too. Rather than forcing myself to choose a descriptive word, I will write the differences between the cup and the doorknob on the medical questionnaire.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Add the difficulty with the doorknob and record the specific actions on the questionnaire. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その具体的な様子を申し送ります。それでは、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on those specific details. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした財布について、詳しく伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I would like to ask you more about your lost wallet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今、店から「財布らしい物がある」と電話が来ました。まだ受け取っていないのですが、この相談はどう続ければよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 店の発見可能連絡と未受領を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The shop just called to say they have something that looks like a wallet. I have not collected it yet. How should I continue with this consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the shop's call about a possible find and that you have not collected it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の財布と確認できたわけではないのですね。店は、何を確認したと言っていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it has not been confirmed to be your wallet. What did the shop say they checked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会員カードの名前が私と同じだそうです。色は聞きましたが、財布を直接見てはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名前一致と未実見を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They said the name on the membership card matches mine. They told me the color, but I have not seen the wallet myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the matching name from the fact that you have not seen it yourself. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見つかった可能性として記録します。お店へ確認に行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will record it as a possible find. Can you go to the shop to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これから行けます。でも、見つかったとだけ言って、私の物か分からないまま相談を終わらせるのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店照会へ行き所有未確認で終わらせないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can go now. But I want to avoid merely saying it was found and ending this consultation without knowing whether it is mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will check at the shop and do not want to close the consultation before ownership is confirmed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人の物と確認して受け取ったら、その結果もお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you confirm that it is yours and collect it, please let us know the result too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。店では中のカードと財布の傷を自分で確認します。違った場合も、そのことを連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 特徴照合と不一致時も結果連絡を約する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. At the shop I will check the cards inside and the scratches on the wallet myself. I will also contact you if it is not mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Promise to compare the identifying details and report the result even if they do not match. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 店からの連絡先は、普段利用しているお店の物と分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you know that the contact number belongs to the shop you normally use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、先ほど私が直接店へ問い合わせた番号です。受領したかどうかを含めて、結果をこちらへ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 既知の店番号と受領有無の報告を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, it is the number I used to contact the shop directly earlier. I will tell you the outcome, including whether I collected it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that it is the known shop number and that you will report whether you collected the wallet. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご確認の結果をお待ちします。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will await the result of your check, then. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの絵はがきをお出しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to send this picture postcard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 料金を確認したいです。ただ、同行している友人も一言書きたいと言っていて、まだ便りは完成していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 料金照会とはがき本文未完成を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to check the postage. However, the friend with me also wants to write a few words, so the message is not finished yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are asking about postage and that the postcard's message is unfinished. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付するのは、記入を終えてからにしましょう。お友達は今こちらにいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us accept it once you have finished writing. Is your friend here now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外で電話しています。私が代わりに名前だけ書けばよいと思いましたが、本人が書きたい内容を聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話中友人の意図を代署で済ませないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are outside on the phone. I thought I could just write their name for them, but I have not asked what they want to write.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will not substitute signing for your friend on the phone without checking their intention. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はがきはいったんお手元へお戻しします。書き終わった時にお声掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will give the postcard back to you for now. Please let us know when you have finished writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。宛名の面には今の住所を残し、友人の文は空けてある場所へ書いてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛名維持と友人記入欄確保を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I will leave the current address on the address side and have my friend write their message in the space I left blank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the address and leave space for your friend to write. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 料金の確認はできますが、そのまま発送した扱いにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check the postage, but that will not mean it has been sent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 料金が分かっても未発送なのですね。友人へ、ここで出すなら自分で一言を書いてほしいと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料金確認を発送済とせず友人記入を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: So even once I know the postage, it remains unsent. I will tell my friend to write a few words themselves if we are sending it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not treat checking postage as sending it, and ask your friend to write. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お友達がお戻りになりましたね。こちらの記入台をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your friend is back now. Please use this writing counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人が自分で書きました。署名も二人分そろったので、今度は完成したはがきとして今日差し出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人の本人記入完成後に今日差出し希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: My friend has written their own message. Both our signatures are now there too, so this time I would like to send the completed postcard today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After both people finish writing themselves, ask to send it today. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、記入済みのはがきを確認して承ります。ご準備ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check the completed postcard and accept it. Thank you for preparing it. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入金の記録について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the deposit records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先月より残高が千十五円増えました。家計ノートへ利息が千十五円と書きましたが、自分で千円入れたことを思い出しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残高千十五増を全利息と記し本人千入金を思い出したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My balance increased by 1,015 yen compared with last month. I wrote 1,015 yen in interest in my household accounts, but then remembered depositing 1,000 yen myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you recorded the whole 1,015-yen balance increase as interest and then remembered your own 1,000-yen deposit. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入金と利息の記録を、それぞれ確認しましょう。ご自身が入れたのは、こちらの日付ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the deposit and interest records separately. Is this the date you deposited the money yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、月曜に現金で千円を入れました。この控えもあります。貯金が増えた全額を銀行が付けてくれたと思ったのは間違いでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人月曜千円入金と控えを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I deposited 1,000 yen in cash on Monday. I have this receipt too. I was wrong to think that the bank had added the whole increase in my savings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your own 1,000-yen cash deposit on Monday and the receipt. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の行には、利息として十五円の入金が記録されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Another line records a deposit of 15 yen as interest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十五円が利息なのですね。家計ノートは、私が足した千円と、この十五円を別の行へ書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記録利息十五円と本人千円を別行へ直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: So 15 yen is the interest. I will rewrite my household accounts with the 1,000 yen I added and these 15 yen on separate lines.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the accounts to show the recorded 15 yen in interest and your own 1,000 yen on separate lines. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの入出金がないかも、期間を合わせてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check whether there were any other deposits or withdrawals over the same period.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この間はほかにありません。次の月も千十五円が自動で増えると予定するのではなく、自分の入金と実際の記録を毎回見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期間他取引なしを確認し翌月同増額を予定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: There were no others during this period. I will not plan on an automatic increase of 1,015 yen again next month, but will check my own deposits and the actual records each time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm no other transactions during that period and do not assume the same increase next month. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご質問だった行の違いは、分かりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you understand the difference between the entries you asked about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。家族に「利息で千円以上増えた」と話したので、私の入金が含まれていたと訂正します。記録を見直せて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族への全利息説明を訂正すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I told my family that interest had increased it by more than 1,000 yen, so I will correct that and explain that my own deposit was included. It helped to review the records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will correct the explanation to your family that the whole increase was interest. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございました。それでは、通帳と控えをお忘れなくお持ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please remember to take your passbook and receipt. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 豆をお探しですか。乾燥した物と調理済みの物があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for beans? We have dried and cooked ones.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は買って運ぶだけで、料理は父がします。乾燥豆を安いからと選びましたが、今日すぐ使えるか父に聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入運搬担当で調理者父の当日準備未確認と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only buy and carry them; my father does the cooking. I chose dried beans because they are cheaper, but I have not asked my father whether he can use them right away today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you handle buying and carrying, while your father cooks, and you have not checked today's preparation. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乾燥品には、調理の準備について表示があります。調理済みとは使い方が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The dried ones have instructions about preparation. They are used differently from the cooked ones.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋に水に浸すと書いてあります。夕方まで父が外出するので、準備する時間がないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 浸水表示と父の外出で準備時間不足を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bag says to soak them in water. My father will be out until evening, so there may not be enough time to prepare them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Consider the soaking instructions and the lack of preparation time because your father is out. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使う料理や、ご家庭の予定も合わせてご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please consider the dish you will use them in and your family's schedule too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父へ電話します。乾燥品を買ってから急いで下ごしらえを頼むのでなく、今日は何を使えるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入前に父へ使用可能品を照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will call my father. Instead of buying the dried ones and then asking him to hurry with the preparation, I will ask what he can use today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask your father which product he can use before buying. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お返事を待つ間、こちらで商品をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please look at the products here while you wait for his reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父は今日は煮込み時間が短いので、調理済みの豆がよいと言っています。乾燥品は私から戻してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 父の調理済希望を伝え未開封乾燥品返却を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: My father says cooked beans would be better because he has little time for simmering today. May I put the dried ones back myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Convey your father's preference for cooked beans and ask about returning the unopened dried ones. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 未開封でしたら、こちらでお戻しします。調理済みの商品の容量もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: If they are unopened, we will put them back for you. Please also check the quantity in the cooked product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 小さい袋を一つ選びます。父には調理済みを買ったと伝え、乾燥豆の準備が済んだと思われないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小袋調理済を選び父へ形態を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose one small bag. I will tell my father I bought cooked beans so he does not think the dried beans have already been prepared.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a small bag of cooked beans and tell your father which form you bought. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらをお戻しします。お買物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will put these back. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 種まき体験へご参加ですね。お持ち帰り用の鉢になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are taking part in the seed-sowing activity, correct? The pot is for you to take home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週また来るので、その日までここで水をあげてもらえると思っていました。今日持ち帰る物なのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鉢の後日引取と当日持帰りを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am coming again next week, so I thought you would water it here until then. Do I have to take it home today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about collecting the pot later versus taking it home today. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 参加者の鉢を、来週までこちらで育てる内容ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The activity does not include growing participants' pots here until next week.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 植えた後に管理してもらう所まで含まれると思い込んでいました。家で置く場所を用意する必要がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 体験後の公園管理を含む誤解を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I assumed looking after it after planting was included. I need to prepare a place to keep it at home, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge your mistaken assumption that park care after the activity was included. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日持ち帰れそうですか。まだ種をまく前ですので、参加の仕方を相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you think you can take it home today? Since you have not sown the seeds yet, we can discuss how you participate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 鉢を持ち運ぶ袋がありませんが、家には窓辺の台があります。持帰りの用意ができれば参加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家庭置場ありと持運び袋なしを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not have a bag to carry the pot, but I have a stand by the window at home. I would like to participate if I can prepare to take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a place at home but no carrying bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの持帰り用の箱を使えます。鉢を傾けずに運んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can use this box for taking it home. Please carry the pot without tilting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 箱が使えるなら参加します。別の人の鉢と取り違えないよう、自分の鉢へ名前を書く場所も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持帰り箱で参加を決め鉢の識別札を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I can use a box, I will participate. I would also like to know where to write my name on my pot so I do not mix it up with someone else's.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to participate using the take-home box and ask about a pot identification label. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 鉢に付ける札へお名前を書いてください。育て方の説明紙は最後にお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please write your name on the label that attaches to the pot. We will give you a care instruction sheet at the end.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 札へ名前を書きました。今日の鉢と説明紙を持ち帰り、来週までここへ預けたままにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名前札と当日鉢説明紙持帰りを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written my name on the label. I will take the pot and instruction sheet home today rather than leaving it here until next week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the name label and taking the pot and instruction sheet home today. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、種をまく準備を始めましょう。体験をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us start preparing to sow the seeds. Enjoy the activity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 座席の変更をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to change seats?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と二人分を別々に買いました。隣に座りたいので、友人の席を私の近くへ変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別購入友人券を本人隣へ変更希望と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend and I bought our two tickets separately. I would like us to sit together, so I want to change my friend's seat to one near mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to change your friend's separately purchased ticket to a seat beside yours. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の切符と、ご友人の切符の条件を確認します。お友達は変更を希望されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the conditions of your ticket and your friend's ticket. Does your friend want to change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ聞いていません。友人は窓側を選んでいたので、隣になるだけで喜ぶとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の窓側希望と未承諾を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not asked yet. My friend chose a window seat, so sitting beside me would not necessarily make them happy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your friend's preference for a window seat and that you have not obtained consent. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 空席のご案内はできますが、ご希望を確かめてから変更をお申し出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can tell you about available seats, but please confirm their preference before requesting a change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人へ、隣になる候補は通路側と伝えます。私の席を動かす案もあるので、どちらがよいか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二案を友人へ尋ねる計画を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will tell my friend that the possible seat beside me is an aisle seat. Moving my seat is another option, so I will ask which they prefer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe your plan to ask your friend about the two options. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この候補なら、お客様が通路側へ移り、お友達は窓側のままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: With this option, you would move to an aisle seat and your friend would keep the window seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人から、窓側を残したいと返事が来ました。友人の券ではなく、私の券の変更を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人返答で本人券のみ変更へ切替える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend replied that they want to keep the window seat. I will ask about changing my ticket instead of my friend's.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Switch to changing only your own ticket based on your friend's reply. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更の条件と費用を確認してご案内します。お友達の券はこちらへ戻してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check and explain the conditions and cost of changing it. May I return your friend's ticket here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、友人の券はそのまま戻してください。私の券だけを出し、費用を聞いてから変更をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人券維持と本人費用確認後変更を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please return my friend's ticket unchanged. I will present only mine and ask for the change after hearing the cost.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to keep your friend's ticket unchanged and change yours after confirming the cost. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご本人の切符を確認します。ご準備ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check your own ticket. Thank you for preparing it. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談会の送迎をお申し込みになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to apply for transport to and from the consultation session?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 行きは自分で来られます。帰りは家族の車ですが、迎えが三十分ほど遅れます。相談時間を延ばすのではなく、待つ場所を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自力往路と遅い家族迎えの待機場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can get there myself. My family will drive me home, but they will arrive about thirty minutes late. I want to ask where I can wait, rather than extend the consultation time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a waiting place for your family's late pickup and explain you can get there yourself. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご相談の終了後に、迎えを待つご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you would like to wait for your ride after the consultation ends.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。家族に急いで運転してもらうつもりはありません。職員の方へ送ってほしいという依頼でもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 運転を急がせず職員送迎も求めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I do not intend to ask my family to hurry while driving. Nor am I asking staff to drive me home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will not rush the driver and are not asking staff for transport. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談会の終了後も、入口側の待合でお待ちいただけます。ただし建物の閉館前までです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can wait in the waiting area by the entrance after the session ends, but only until the building closes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 迎えは閉館時刻より前です。相談担当の席を使い続けず、終了したら待合へ移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 閉館前迎えと相談席から待合移動を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: My pickup is before closing time. I will move to the waiting area when the consultation ends instead of continuing to occupy the consultation seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that pickup is before closing and you will move from the consultation seat to the waiting area. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 家族の方は、お待ちになる場所をご存じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does your family know where you will be waiting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今までは相談の部屋だと思っていました。待合の入口へ来るよう、場所を伝え直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ迎え場所を待合へ訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Until now they thought it would be the consultation room. I will tell them the location again and ask them to come to the waiting area entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Correct the pickup location to the waiting area for your family. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 迎えがさらに遅れる場合は、受付へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please inform reception if your ride is delayed further.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 閉館までに来られないと分かったら、別の帰り方を家族と相談して受付にも伝えます。今は送迎の申込みはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: さらに遅れる時の代替相談と送迎不要を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: If I find out they cannot arrive before closing, I will discuss another way home with my family and tell reception too. I will not apply for transport now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will discuss an alternative if pickup is further delayed and do not need transport. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、相談会当日にお待ちしております。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We look forward to seeing you on the day of the consultation. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待ち時間について、何かご心配ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you concerned about the waiting time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 隣の方が「あと一人」と言ったので、私も次だと思っていました。でも、その方は別の診療科でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別科患者あと一人発言を本人順と誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The person next to me said 'one more person,' so I thought I was next too. But they were seeing a different department.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook another department patient's 'one more person' remark for your own place in line. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の受付情報で確認します。ほかの方の順番とは同じとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check your own registration information. Your turn is not necessarily the same as someone else's.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の番号はこちらです。隣の方の番号は見せてもらっていないので、同じ列だと私が考えただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人番号提示と他人番号未確認を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is my number. I have not seen the number of the person beside me, so I merely assumed we were in the same queue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your own number and explain that you have not checked the other person's. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この受付では診療科ごとにご案内しています。今の状況は担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: This reception calls patients by department. I will check the current situation with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。隣の方へ何度も次かと聞くのはやめます。自分の予定を組むため、確認できる範囲だけ知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他患者再質問をやめ本人状況確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will stop repeatedly asking the person beside me whether I am next. I only want to know what can be confirmed so I can plan my day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stop asking the other patient again and ask for your own situation to be checked. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ正確な案内時刻は出ていません。予定への影響はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We do not yet have an exact time for calling you. Does this affect your plans?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昼に宅配の受取りがあります。間に合うと決めて家族へ返事をせず、受診がまだ終わっていないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宅配予定を未確定終了時刻で約束しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a delivery to receive at midday. Instead of telling my family I will definitely make it, I will tell them my appointment is not finished yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not promise to receive the delivery based on an uncertain appointment end time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 待つ間に席を離れる場合は、受付へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you need to leave your seat while waiting, please consult reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。案内が出たら自分の番号を確認し、他の方の「次」という言葉だけでは診察室へ向かいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付待機し本人番号の案内で移動する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait here. When someone is called, I will check my own number and will not go to the examination room merely because someone else says 'next.'
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait at reception and move when your own number is called. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当の案内をお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please wait for the staff to call you. Take care.
